notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]Now for each action you will get the result described in the pop-up window![/b]

How does it work?
Previously, all the action was hidden from the player and you could think that the game is going in absolute chaos. Now all the events are related and you will know what will happen next!

For example, selecting the "rob" option will result in "it would be more useful to me" or something along those lines if the robbery is successful. If you don't succeed or something else strange happens, that will also be notified.

notes.title: RELEASE DETAILS
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here are the details that will give you a more concrete idea of the mysterious world of this game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/70aec1c1464d690ecf7a01085af323e80d2cd02f.png[/img]

[h1]-GAMEPLAY DETAILS-[/h1]

[h2]Classes[/h2]
Choose your play style so that you can reach your goal. The outcome is up to you. Try various strategies to change the fate of this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/944f2e28132e424efff3e47df75749affb50b8fe.gif[/img]

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
The artifacts in this world are called "[b]soul items[/b]". Each of them can change the behavior of the world. You can use an unlimited number of soul items if you can carry them with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/58c3a9ac8d75828548e88c8c0ae8e7a111e39af8.gif[/img]

[h2]Craft[/h2]
Create anything from common items to those unknown to the world. This is often more profitable than buying items from the store. The only problem is that you have to search all over the continent for recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/fa404e0d1051752b34b3ac75a2cc98b0595d116e.gif[/img]

[h2]Characteristics Increase[/h2]
Exercise to strengthen your body. You can't always rely solely on equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/48bd1eab0e649f5363ddcf68ad27d9b13c26f28d.gif[/img]

[h2]Death[/h2]
It's almost impossible to remain unharmed in this world. You might be killed by a demon or make the wrong choice. But you don't have to worry. As you progress, you are rewarded with a [b]soul life[/b] that will help you resurrect. When it's over... Well, you know that yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43925453/d6c0083540738c1d76175171be29811b3608c986.gif[/img]

[h1]-RELEASE-[/h1]
The full version of Weak Soul will be released on [b]6/29/2023. The digital version will be available for $9.99 USD[/b] (or your regional equivalent).
